hostObligations: Extract module then clause unconditionally before readiness; presence is strict !== undefined.
Find namespace, extract local, then lazily call Map.has only when local exists.
Extract first and last identifier texts before specifier admission; Map.has is lazy after both presence checks.
Keep native descendants/filter iteration, original Map.set ordering, keys, path and imported name.
Read and test statement text only after successful admission; named specifier text and regex are lazy if statement regex is false.
Namespace writes survive later specifier rejection; no transactional rollback.
Preserve native exceptions and outer catch behavior; do not normalize null or source text.
Admission ABI is boolean, never a type predicate; host assertions after admission are erased.
Regex correctness, parser structure, native name identity and IO are outside these conditional proofs.
Empty strings are present; a single identifier still yields two separate text reads.
Statement regex repeats per accepted entry; namespace never evaluates specifier regex.
Map.set method is obtained before evaluating regex/text in its value argument.
All earlier namespace and named writes survive later failure; outer collector returns undefined.
Default/side-effect import support is unchanged; binding extraction completeness is unproved.
